Welcome to Sauramandala! 🌱

Please reply with the number for your language:
1 - English
2 - Khasi
3 - Garo
4 - Pnar
Please select from the list — tap the menu button to choose your language.

Before we continue, do you agree to receive messages from Sauramandala on WhatsApp?

Reply:
1 or YES to join
2 or NO to decline
No problem. You won't receive further messages. Reply ONBOARD anytime to come back. 🙏
Please tap Yes to join or No to decline.

Which programme are you part of?

1 - TFFP (Early Childhood Education)
2 - CMYC (Youth Centre)
3 - OESN / Doorstep (Entrepreneur Support)
4 - Core Team
Please select from the list — tap the menu button to choose your programme.
Almost there! What is your full name? Please type it below 👇

What is your role in TFFP?

1 - Anganwadi Worker
2 - Preschool Teacher
3 - Parent
4 - Home-based Provider
Please select your role from the list.

What is your role in CMYC?

1 - Centre Coordinator
2 - Youth Member
3 - Volunteer
Please tap one of the buttons to select your role.

What is your role in OESN / Doorstep?

1 - Field Agent
2 - Entrepreneur
3 - Vendor / Provider
Please tap one of the buttons to select your role.

What is your role in the Core Team?

1 - Programme Manager
2 - District Coordinator
3 - Other Staff
Please tap one of the buttons to select your role.

One more for parents 👶

What is your child's date of birth?
Please type in DD/MM/YYYY format (e.g. 15/03/2023)

Last one! Which district are you based in?

Please type your district name (e.g. East Khasi Hills, West Garo Hills, Ri Bhoi)

You're all set! ✅

Welcome to Sauramandala! 🌱

Your profile has been saved. Your programme team will be in touch soon.

Reply STOP at any time to leave.
